purpose: Identify the original NVIDIA FY2018-FY2024 10-K accessions needed to explain the FY2019, FY2022 and FY2023 inventory/revenue annual-pair gaps in the existing frozen source qualification.
selection_rule: Match CIK, exact reportDate and form=10-K; retain any duplicate or missing original as ambiguity. Do not select 10-K/A, later comparatives or a current companyfacts row to fill a gap.
decision_rule: If all seven originals are uniquely located, freeze a separate bounded source-context audit for the exact filings. Submission metadata alone is neither original financial values nor historical point-in-time qualification.
